questions: What is the value of the stock in each category (unit price times units in stock)? Return the category name and the stock value.
How many invoices were issued in each month of 2024? Return the month (1-12) and the count.
What is the average invoice total in each billing country with more than 10 invoices? Return the country and the average.

sql: SELECT c.category_name, sum(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_sales FROM categories AS c JOIN products AS p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_details AS od ON p.product_id = od.product_id GROUP BY c.category_name
explanation: Calculates total sales revenue for each product category using order line details and discounts.
